cohort: The study included 86 late preterm infants with a gestational age of 34-36(+6) weeks who were admitted to Maternity & Child Care Center of Qinhuangdao between June 2022 and June 2023.
finding: Male fetal gender, placental abnormalities, intrauterine distress, premature rupture of membranes, and gestational diabetes mellitus were identified as risk factors for NRDS in late preterm infants.
mod_finding: There were statistically significant differences in mode of delivery between the NRDS and non-NRDS groups (p<0.05).
birth_weight: N/A (no specific values or ranges provided, only that there was no significant difference between groups)
